title: Representation of the People Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 2002
REPRESENTATION OF PEOPLE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
10th July, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 10-7-2002.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Representation of People (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 11, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 2002
REPRESENTATION OF PEOPLE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
10th July, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 10-7-2002.--The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 11, Act LXXXV of 1976.--In the
Representation of People Act, 1976 (Act LXXXV of 1976), in section 11, in
subsection (1),--
(i) after the word
"Commission", the commas and words "not later than thirty days
of such announcement," shall be inserted; and
(ii) in clause (b), for the words
"two days" the words "seven days" shall be substituted.
